summary: Exozymes Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, under Items 8.01 and 9.01, disclosing that its 2026 annual meeting of shareholders will be held on November 13, 2026. The record date was September 15, 2026, and the proxy statement and proxy are expected to be distributed on or about September 28, 2026. No transactional or special-situation event is described; the filing merely sets meeting logistics. No deal terms, advisors, or board recommendations are stated. Watch for the forthcoming proxy for any proposals or governance matters.
